title: docs: replace retiring gpt-5 model names in OpenAI examples

files.patch:
@@ -78,7 +78,7 @@ icon: "rocket"
 
   ```bash example
   # Examples (pick one that matches your provider/account):
-  LLM_CHAT_MODEL_NAME="openai:gpt-5-mini"
+  LLM_CHAT_MODEL_NAME="openai:gpt-5.6-terra"
   ```

@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ from beeai_framework.agents.requirement import RequirementAgent
 llm = ChatModel.from_name("ollama:granite3.3")
 
 # Using OpenAI
-llm = ChatModel.from_name("openai:gpt-5-mini")
+llm = ChatModel.from_name("openai:gpt-5.6-terra")
 
 # Using Anthropic
 llm = ChatModel.from_name("anthropic:claude-sonnet-4")
@@ -60,7 +60,7 @@ import { ChatModel } from "beeai-framework/backend/chat";
 llm = await ChatModel.from_name("ollama:granite3.3")
 
 # Using OpenAI
-llm = await ChatModel.from_name("openai:gpt-5-mini")
+llm = await ChatModel.from_name("openai:gpt-5.6-terra")
 
 # Using Anthropic
 llm = await ChatModel.from_name("anthropic:claude-sonnet-4")
